summary: Comprehensive testing of Kazandıran Çark (Spinning Wheel) application completed. Backend APIs are fully functional with 12/12 tests passing. Frontend has critical SelectItem component bug in admin panel that prevents extra spin functionality. Daily spin limit enforcement has issues allowing multiple spins.

ui_bugs.issue: React error: 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string' - prevents extra spin modal from working
ui_bugs.affected_functionality: Admin cannot grant extra spins to users

ui_bugs.issue: Daily spin limit not properly enforced - users can spin multiple times per day
ui_bugs.affected_functionality: Users can bypass daily spin restrictions

integration_issues.issue: Extra spin modal fails to open due to SelectItem component error

issues: Multiple 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' warnings

passed_tests: Frontend wheel spinning animation and prize display
Frontend admin login and panel navigation
Frontend prize display and status tracking

success_percentage.frontend: 85% (critical admin functionality broken, daily limits not enforced)

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical SelectItem component bug in admin panel that prevents extra spin functionality. The error is 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string' in the user selection dropdown. Also fix daily spin limit enforcement - users can currently spin multiple times per day when they should be limited to once.
